description: This Java class manages resource folders in an Android project within an IDE, handling resource directory retrieval, change notifications, and integration with Gradle and Maven dependencies.

classes.name: ResourceFolderManager
classes.description: Manages resource directories for an Android project, including caching, change notifications, and dependency analysis.

classes.name: ResourceFolderListener
classes.description: Interface for listening to resource folder changes.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates the cached resource folder list, forcing a refresh and notifying listeners if changed.

methods.name: getFolders
methods.description: Returns the list of resource directories, computing them if not cached.

methods.name: computeFolders
methods.description: Computes resource directories based on project type (Gradle or non-Gradle) and project state.

methods.name: notifyChanged
methods.description: Notifies registered listeners of changes in resource folders.

methods.name: getModificationCount
methods.description: Returns the current modification count for change tracking.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for resource folder changes.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Unregisters a listener for resource folder changes.

methods.name: addAarsFromModuleLibraries
methods.description: Adds resource directories from AAR dependencies in module libraries.

methods.name: isAarDependency
methods.description: Checks if an order entry is an AAR dependency.

methods.name: isLibraryResourceFile
methods.description: Checks if a file is a resource file from a library (AAR).

methods.name: isLibraryResourceFolder
methods.description: Checks if a folder is a resource folder from a library (AAR).

methods.name: isLibraryResourceRoot
methods.description: Checks if a resource folder is an extracted library resource root (AAR).
